verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a local model runner like Ollama, but the evidence pack documents no export feature, open-format data dump, or migration path for models, chats, or settings. Local data residency ("Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine") is an adjacent privacy claim, not an export capability. A community report even describes lock-in through a proprietary registry format with hashed filenames that other tools can't read.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
